## Summary

I implemented **F010** — the end-to-end "after git pull" update journey for `dontpanic doctor` — as a new test module `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_update_journey_e2e_f010.py` (3 tests, all green; no source changes were needed since F006/F007/F008 already shipped the surfaces).
